div.div:
Use Case: "OPEN BANK CURRENT ACCOUNT"
Main Scenario:
(1) The customer comes to the bank to open a new current account . (2) The bank employee welcomes the customer and provides explanations .
(3) If the customer agrees, they provide their personal information.
(4) The employee checks whether the customer is already registered in the system.
(5) The employee creates the new current account.
(6) Finally, the employee communicates the account number to the customer.
Variants:
(3a) If the customer does not agree, the use case ends.
(3b) If the account is to be held jointly by multiple people, the personal data of all account holders must be provided.
(4a) If the customer (or any of the joint account holders) is not registered, the employee proceeds to register them, requests the customer's signature on the specimen form, and stores it using a scanner.
